text: On 20 February 2023, the user said they were looking for gift ideas for their siblings and had that day ordered a customized phone case for their friend's birthday, which the friend really loves.

The assistant suggested sibling gift ideas for a tech-savvy sibling: a portable power bank, a wireless charging pad, a high-tech smartwatch or fitness tracker, or a gaming console. For a bookworm sibling it suggested a new book, a book club or e-book subscription, a reading pillow or booklight, or a bookstore gift card.

The assistant suggested gift ideas for a creative sibling (art supplies, a musical instrument or lessons, a photography kit or lens, a crafting kit), an adventurous sibling (event tickets, rock climbing or escape rooms, outdoor gear, a travel bag) and a foodie sibling (a food or wine subscription, a cookbook, a kitchen appliance, a restaurant or cooking class gift card).
On 20 February 2023, the user said their sister is really into fashion and their brother loves playing video games.

The assistant suggested gift ideas for the user's fashionista sister: a gift card to her favourite store such as Zara, H&M or Sephora, trendy accessories, a specific item she has been eyeing, a fashion magazine subscription, or a personalised item such as a monogrammed tote.

The assistant suggested gift ideas for the user's gamer brother: a recently released game he has been eyeing, a gaming keyboard, controller or high-performance mouse, a subscription such as Xbox Game Pass, PlayStation Now or NVIDIA GeForce NOW, a gaming headset, or tickets to a gaming event or tournament.
On 20 February 2023, the user said they think their sister would really like a trendy accessory such as a new handbag, and asked for recommendations of handbags that are currently popular.

The assistant listed trendy handbag styles: bucket bags (Zara, Mango, Madewell), mini bags (Jacquemus, By Far, Alexander Wang), chain-bag styles (Chanel, Gucci, Prada) and satchels (Coach, Kate Spade, Michael Kors).
The assistant gave approximate handbag price ranges: Zara about $20-$50, H&M about $10-$30, Mango about $50-$100, Chanel about $1,000-$5,000, and both Gucci and Prada about $500-$2,000.
On 20 February 2023, the user said they planned to stick to a budget of around $100-$200 for the handbag, because they wanted something nice without breaking the bank.

The assistant suggested Zara handbags within $100-$200: City Bag ($129), Bucket Bag ($99) and Mini Bag ($79). It suggested Mango handbags: Leather Tote ($149), Suede Bag ($129) and Mini Shoulder Bag ($99).

The assistant also suggested Kate Spade's Cameron Street Bag ($178), Watson Lane Bag ($148) and Mini Maise Bag ($128), plus the Madewell Transport Tote ($168), Frye Melissa Bag ($178) and Sam Edelman Hazel Bag ($148).
On 20 February 2023, the user said they would take a closer look at the Zara City Bag and asked for more details about it.

The assistant described the Zara City Bag as having a structured shape, gold-tone hardware including a buckle closure and feet, a lined interior with a front pocket and a larger inside pocket, adjustable straps, and high-quality polyurethane (PU) material with a soft, smooth finish.

The assistant said the Zara City Bag measures 10.2 inches (26 cm) long, 7.5 inches (19 cm) high and 4.3 inches (11 cm) wide, weighs about 1.3 pounds (590 grams), comes in black, beige and navy blue, and costs $129.
On 11 August 2023, the user said they were planning a dinner party and asked for popular Korean BBQ dishes that are easy to make in large quantities.

The assistant recommended Korean BBQ dishes for a dinner party: bulgogi made with thinly sliced marinated ribeye or sirloin, galbi (marinated short ribs), dak galbi (spicy gochujang-based chicken), pork belly BBQ and japchae, with sundubu jjigae and kimchi stew as other options.

The assistant gave large-batch Korean BBQ tips: marinate meat in bulk and refrigerate or freeze it, grill in batches, prepare kimchi, rice and japchae in advance, and consider a DIY BBQ station with toppings such as kimchi, lettuce, garlic and gochujang.
The assistant suggested serving banchan such as kimchi, pickled radish and seasoned spinach with the Korean BBQ, and pairing the meal with Korean beers such as Cass or Hite.

On 11 August 2023, the user said they planned to serve several cuisines at the dinner party, taking a few Korean BBQ options and pairing them with Indian and Middle Eastern dishes, and asked for Indian dishes that are easy to make in large quantities.

The assistant recommended Indian dishes that scale well for a crowd: chana masala, palak paneer, samosas, tandoori chicken, vegetable biryani, rogan josh and sag aloo, each with suggested accompaniments of basmati rice, naan or roti.

The assistant gave large-quantity Indian cooking tips: prepare sauces and spice blends in advance, use large pots, consider a slow cooker or Instant Pot, and make extra rice and naan for unexpected guests or second helpings.

The assistant suggested Middle Eastern dishes to pair with the Korean and Indian food: shawarma with tahini sauce, hummus with pita bread, and tabbouleh made with bulgur, parsley, tomatoes, mint and lemon juice.
On 11 August 2023, the user said they were thinking of making falafel as one of the Middle Eastern options and asked for tips on making it crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside.

The assistant's tips for crispy falafel: use dry chickpeas soaked overnight and well drained, add a spice blend of cumin, coriander, paprika and cayenne, pulse coarsely without making a paste, and chill the mixture for at least 30 minutes before shaping.

The assistant advised double-frying falafel: 2-3 minutes at 325°F (165°C) to cook the inside, then 2-3 minutes at 375°F (190°C) to crisp the outside, draining on paper towels. For a fluffy interior it advised not over-mixing, binding with egg, breadcrumbs and/or oats, frying in batches and not overcooking.
On 11 August 2023, the user said they had been experimenting with different types of noodles lately and asked for popular Korean noodle dishes they could try making at home.
The assistant recommended Korean noodle dishes to make at home: naengmyeon, ramyeon, jjajangmyeon, japchae, bibim naengmyeon, kalguksu and haemultang, a spicy seafood noodle soup.

The assistant's Korean noodle tips: use noodles designed for Korean dishes such as naengmyeon or ramyeon, season with gochujang, soy sauce and sesame oil, adjust the spice level to taste, and serve with kimchi, pickled ginger or boiled eggs.

On 11 August 2023, the user asked whether the assistant had tried any good Korean restaurants in its city lately, saying the user had recently tried three different ones, each with its own unique flavour and style.

The assistant said it is an AI with no personal experiences, taste buds or physical presence in a city, so it had not tried any Korean restaurants, and asked the user to share what they ordered and what stood out at each of the three restaurants.

On 11 August 2023, the user said one recently tried Korean restaurant had an amazing bibimbap, another had a really spicy kimchi stew, and a third had a unique japchae made with sweet potato noodles that was really tasty.

The assistant said bibimbap combines crispy rice, savoury vegetables and a runny egg, that kimchi jjigae is a popular spicy kimchi stew for those who like heat, and that sweet potato noodles give japchae a lovely sweetness.
On 30 September 2023, the user said they were planning a dinner party with Korean-style BBQ beef and asked for side dish recommendations that would complement it well.

The assistant recommended traditional Korean side dishes for BBQ beef: kimchi, bokkeumbap (fried rice), sigeumchi (garlic and sesame spinach), gyeranjjim (steamed egg), oi muchim (cucumber salad), japchae, kongnamul muchim (bean sprout salad) and gyeran-mari (rolled omelette).

On 30 September 2023, the user said they would go with kimchi and bokkeumbap, and asked whether the assistant had tried any good Korean restaurants in their city, having tried four different ones so far.

The assistant said it is a large language model without personal experiences or a physical presence, so it had not tried Korean restaurants in the user's city, and suggested Yelp, Google Reviews, TripAdvisor, food blogs, Korean community centres and asking friends for recommendations.

On 30 September 2023, the user said they were thinking of changing the dinner party menu and asked for Indian-inspired recipe ideas that would complement the Korean BBQ beef and Middle Eastern falafel.
The assistant suggested Indian-inspired dishes for the dinner party: appetizers samosas and papri chaat; sides basmati rice, saag aloo and raita; and desserts gulab jamun and kulfi.
On 30 September 2023, the user said they would go with the samosas and saag aloo, and asked for a good brand of basmati rice, having been trying out different types of rice lately.

The assistant recommended basmati rice brands Tilda (a UK brand with premium and value options), India Gate, Daawat, Zebra (a US brand known for black and white striped packaging) and Lundberg (organic and non-organic options).

The assistant said good basmati has a nutty, buttery aroma, long slender separate grains and a light, fluffy texture with a slightly firm bite, that older rice is often considered better, and advised soaking the rice and using the right water ratio so it does not turn mushy.

On 30 September 2023, the user said they had been using an authentic Japanese short-grain rice and asked whether it would suit the samosas and saag aloo, or whether they should stick with traditional Indian basmati.

The assistant said Japanese short-grain rice is stickier and clingier than basmati and suits Japanese dishes better, so it recommended traditional Indian basmati, though short-grain rice could be tried as a fusion option with an adjusted water ratio and cooking time.

On 30 September 2023, the user said they would stick with traditional Indian basmati rice and would pick up a bag from the store later that day. They had also heard a new Indian restaurant had just opened in their neighbourhood with an amazing chicken tikka masala, and planned to try it.

The assistant said it has no real-time information about specific local businesses, so it could not confirm the new Indian restaurant, and suggested checking Yelp or Google Reviews or asking friends, family or colleagues for recommendations.

The assistant recommended science fiction and fantasy audiobooks: The Three-Body Problem by Liu Cixin (narrated by Luke Daniels), The First Fifteen Lives of Harry August by Claire North (narrated by Peter Kenny) and The Lies of Locke Lamora by Scott Lynch (narrated by Simon Vance).

On 23 May 2023, the user said they were already reading Gone Girl on their Kindle and asked for more information about The Nightingale.

The assistant said The Nightingale is a historical fiction novel by Kristin Hannah, published in 2015 and a New York Times bestseller, that follows sisters Vianne and Isabelle Rossignol in France during World War II.

The assistant said Vianne is married with a young daughter and becomes involved in the French Resistance, risking her life to help downed airmen escape, while the rebellious younger sister Isabelle joins the Resistance at a young age, and their bond is tested by differing views on survival.
The assistant said the audiobook is narrated by Polly Stone and runs about 17 hours and 30 minutes, and that the novel's themes include sisterhood, bravery, survival and love.
On 23 May 2023, the user said they had heard audiobooks can be great for multitasking and asked for note-taking apps that work well with audiobooks.

The assistant recommended note-taking apps for audiobooks: Notion (web, iOS, Android), Simplenote (web, iOS, Android), Bear (iOS, Android), Evernote (web, iOS, Android), Otter (iOS, Android) and the Audiobooks.com app's built-in notes (iOS, Android).

The assistant said useful audiobook note-taking features include timestamps that link notes to positions in the audiobook, tagging and organisation, robust search, cloud syncing across devices, and customisation.

On 23 May 2023, the user said they used the Audible app, which lets them bookmark and add notes, and asked whether any of the suggested apps can export notes or quotes in a format that is easy to share on social media.

The assistant said Notion exports notes as CSV, JSON or Markdown, Simplenote as plain text, Markdown or HTML, Bear as plain text, Markdown or HTML with a quote feature, Evernote as HTML, PDF or plain text, and Otter exports quotes as images with attribution.

The assistant said Notion can share notes directly to Twitter, Slack or Trello, Bear, Evernote and Otter can share to Twitter, Facebook or LinkedIn, and some apps may limit exports or shares depending on the plan.

The assistant asked whether the user has a specific note-taking method for audiobooks, such as a dedicated notebook, a note-taking app or a combination of both.
On 28 May 2023, the user said they were planning a trip to Asia and asked for must-visit places in Tokyo, having previously visited Japan from April 15th to 22nd and fallen in love with the city.

The assistant recommended off-the-beaten-path Tokyo spots: the neon districts Kabukicho in Shinjuku, Gyoza Stadium in Ikebukuro and Harmonica Yokocho in Kichijoji, plus teamLab Borderless in Odaiba, Kagurazaka, Yanaka with Yanaka Ginza, and Golden Gai.
The assistant also suggested sumo at Ryogoku Kokugikan (held in January, May and September), Todoroki Valley, the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka, Ameya Yokocho in Ueno and Tsukishima for monjayaki.
On 28 May 2023, the user said they were planning to visit other Asian cities besides Tokyo and asked for popular destinations within a 5-hour flight radius of Tokyo.

The assistant highlighted Seoul's palaces, markets and Korean BBQ, Taipei's night markets and Taipei 101, Beijing's Great Wall, Forbidden City and Peking duck, and Hanoi's Old Quarter, pho and banh mi.

On 24 May 2023, the user said they would try Carmine's, having heard good things about it, and asked for hotel recommendations near the restaurant.

The assistant listed hotels near the Streeterville location: Loews Chicago Hotel (about 0.2 miles, 4-minute walk), The Sheraton Grand Chicago (about 0.3 miles, 6-minute walk) and Hyatt Centric The Loop Chicago (about 0.4 miles, 8-minute walk).

On 24 May 2023, the user said they would check out The Wit Hotel because they liked the sound of its rooftop bar, and that during their last trip in March they had enjoyed exploring Chicago, especially walking along the Lake Michigan shoreline.

The assistant said The Wit Hotel's rooftop bar is called ROOF, and described the lakefront path, which runs from North Avenue Beach to Navy Pier, with nearby beaches Oak Street Beach and North Avenue Beach.
The assistant said Millennium Park is a short walk from The Wit Hotel and features Cloud Gate (The Bean), the Jay Pritzker Pavilion and Lurie Garden.
